name: seedsigner-dev
notes: the latest release, 0.8.7 (June 2026), predates every PSBT check merged since September 2026 and is not tested here.

`op-return-with-value`: the value of an OP_RETURN output is counted in no total at this commit. Open PR [SeedSigner#1043](https://github.com/SeedSigner/seedsigner/pull/1043) shows each OP_RETURN output and what it burns.
`segwit-v0-inputs-without-prev-tx`: documented in `PSBTParser._verify_input_amounts_and_scripts` as a known limitation.

name: krux-develop
notes: the latest release, 26.09.0 (September 2026), is not tested here.

`op-return-with-value`: any PSBT with an OP_RETURN output is refused with a TypeError during review, which is safe. Open PR [krux#969](https://github.com/selfcustody/krux/pull/969) shows OP_RETURN outputs.
`change-at-huge-index`: reported to the maintainers privately on 2026-11-18. They confirmed it and suggested a public issue: [krux#999](https://github.com/selfcustody/krux/issues/999).

name: bdk-wallet-sign
notes: BDK is a library, so the review is what a wallet built on it gets from it: the fee from `PsbtUtils::fee_amount` and the outputs sorted with `Wallet::is_mine`.
`Wallet::sign` is deprecated in 3.2.0, and [bdk_wallet#647](https://github.com/bitcoindevkit/bdk_wallet/pull/647) removes it for 4.0.

`outputs-exceed-inputs`: `PsbtUtils::fee_amount` panics. Open issue [bdk_wallet#558](https://github.com/bitcoindevkit/bdk_wallet/issues/558), fix in [PR #564](https://github.com/bitcoindevkit/bdk_wallet/pull/564). Counted as a refusal, since a wallet that crashes signs nothing.
`legacy-input-without-prev-tx`, `segwit-v0-inputs-without-prev-tx` and the sighash cases: the review shows the PSBT's own numbers, then `Wallet::sign` refuses to sign.

name: psbt-sign-alone
library: `bitcoin::Psbt::sign`, with the same review as bdk-wallet-sign
notes: not a wallet: `Psbt::sign` is a low-level primitive that checks neither input amounts nor sighash types, as bdk_wallet#647 notes. This column shows what the checks in psbt-sign-with-checks protect against.

name: psbt-sign-with-checks
notes: the two checks are copied unchanged into `adapters/bdk/src/checks.rs`; the review is the same as bdk-wallet-sign.
